Fake encounters in J & K
*221. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
innocent civilians were killed in fake
encounters undertaken jointly by some
officials of the Indian Army and the local
police in J & K;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether a Committee has been set
up to inquire into the matter;
(d) if so, the details thereof and the time-
frame set for submission of the report by
the Committee; and
(e) the measures proposed to be taken
by Government to ensure that such fake
encounters do not take place and innocent
civilians are not killed?
 Light helicopter deal with
Eurocopter
*222. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that $ 600 million
deal of Europe's Eurocopter for supply of
light helicopter to the Army is being kept
on hold;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) by when it would be finally cleared?
Categorisation of TV programmes
†*223. SHRI SHATRUGHAN SINHA:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are going to
formulate any such rules under which the
T.V.  programmes would be divided into
three categories and the time of their
broadcasting would also be fixed;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the purpose behind the formulation
of such rules?
Low export of medicinal herbal products
*224. SHRI B. K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether China exports medicinal

71
herbal products worth $ 5 billion against
India's Rs. 200 million;
(b) whether a major share of India's
medicinal herbal exports go to China in raw
form, where it undergoes value addition and
is re-exported; and
(c) if so, the details thereof ?
Progress made in fencing along Indo-
Bangladesh Border
*225. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the status of progress made in wired
fencing along the Indo-Bangladesh border;
(b) whether it is a fact that there could
be a possibility of delay in the completion
of wired fencing;
(c) if so, the reasons for the delay and
possible date of completion;
(d) whether it is also a fact that at several
places, the existing fence has been removed
and poles have been uprooted; and
(e) if so, the reasons for poor
maintenance and the steps being taken to
maintain the wired fencing?
 Survey on Indian languages
*226. SHRI B. J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to conduct a
survey on Indian languages;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) when such last survey was
conducted and what are its statistics?
Labour rights of women workers
*227. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to ensure the labour rights of
women working in the unorganised sector;
(b) whether the Ministry has any plan
to protect women in unorganised sector from
the incidents of sexual harassment; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Schemes and master plan at district
level
*228. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: W ill the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating any proposal regarding
preparing schemes and master plan at
district level for planned development of
rural areas;
(b) the States and districts of the
country for which the schemes and master
plan are proposed to be prepared in the
beginning;
(c) the present status of the proposal;
and
(d) by when, this proposal is likely to
be accorded final shape?
 Insufficient potable water in Ranikhet
and Lansdown Cantonments
†*229. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that

Production of different varieties of
tobacco
1674. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity and value of
unmanufactured tobacco produced in India;
(b) the break-up of the above
production into different types and varieties
of tobacco like flue cured Virginia tobacco,
bidi tobacco, chewing tobacco, snuff and
hookah tobacco; and
(c) the respective exports of such
tobacco in 2006-07, splitting up the export
figures according to the varieties?
 Export of unmanufactured tobacco
1675. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total quantity of
unmanufactured tobacco produced in India,
State-wise;
(b) the total exports of unmanufactured
tobacco from India during the last three
years, year-wise;
(c) whether Government is encouraging
export of unmanufactured tobacco from
India to benefit tobacco farmers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Tariff Rate Quota on Indian tobacco
by USA
1676. DR. M.A.M.
RAMASWAMY:
 SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India exports
unmanufactured tobacco to USA and other
countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof in 2006-07
and in the current financial year, so far;
(c) whether it is a fact that USA imposes
Tariff Rate Quota on Indian
unmanufactured tobacco;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;

387
(e) whether Government has raised this
matter with the appropriate US agency;
and
(f) the steps proposed to be taken to
ensure fairness to Indian farmers by
removing all restrictions from the USA?
 Foreign and domestic investment in
retail trade
†1677. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of companies granted
permission for carrying out retail trade in
the country;
(b) the details of foreign capital
investment and domestic capital investment
in the retail trade; and
(c) the State-wise details of number of
persons provided with jobs after putting a
ban on the entry of corporate companies in
the retail business?
 Meeting of tobacco growers
association
1678. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has called a
meeting of tobacco growers associations in
2007-08 to discuss their problems;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what were the demands;
(d) whether it is a fact that easy entry
of imported cigarettes has harmed Andhra
Pradesh tobacco farmers; and
(e) the steps proposed to plug the
loopholes and assist Indian tobacco
farmers?
 Setting up of Spice Parks
1679. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up Spice Parks in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and what
fiscal and financial incentives shall be given
to these parks;
(c) whether the locations of such parks
have been identified;
(d) if so, who identifies the location and
what is the size of such parks;
(e) who will be responsible for
developing the infrastructure in such parks;
and
(f) what will be the role and obligations
of the respective State Governments?
 MPEDA links with Indian Ocean
Tuna Commission
1680. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Marine Products Export
Development Authority (MPEDA)
developed links with Indian Ocean Tuna
Commission (IOTC);
(b) the nature of MPEDA's links and
institutional arrangement with IOTC;
(c) in what way does MPEDA have the
technical expertise to implement the
IOTC's agenda in India;
(d) whether it is a fact that MPEDA
organized and visited foreign countries to
tie-up its interest with the IOTC; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

388
(e) the steps proposed to cancel all such
agreements by MPEDA involving
distracting activities?
 Ban on import of rice on phyto-
sanitary grounds by Russia
1681. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Russia has banned the
import of rice from India on phyto-sanitary
and sanitary grounds;
(b) whether Government has
ascertained the objections by Russian
importers;
(c) if so, whether such objections are in
conformity with the WTO regulations in
this respect; and
(d) what steps are being taken to remove
such non-tariff restrictions on the Indian
farm exports?
 Probe into cartelisation of cement
industry by MRTPC
1682. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of  COMMERCE AND
